title: Integrability of a Rademacher summand
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $a$ be a real-valued function on the $n$ coordinates, let $i$ be one of those coordinates, and let $p$ be an extended nonnegative real number. Under the uniform measure on sign vectors of length $n$, the function sending a sign vector $x$ to $a(i)$ times its sign at coordinate $i$ belongs to $L^p$.
hypotheses_covered: The coefficient function is real-valued on the $n$ coordinates
The exponent is an extended nonnegative real number
The measure is uniform on sign vectors of length $n$
